description: This source file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'AttendanceReportSearchFilterParams' within the OrangeHRM HRM system. The class extends date range filter capabilities and adds specific properties for filtering attendance reports, such as job title ID, subunit ID, employment status ID, and employee numbers. It also includes a set of allowed sort fields and uses traits for subunit chain handling.
